description: Розклад руху громадського транспорту м.Корюківка is a dataset listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Корюківська міська рада. Набір містить розклади руху громадського транспорту по місту Корюківка. Coverage: Корюківська міська рада. The publisher named on the listing is Корюківська міська рада. Its keywords include автобус, громадський транспорт, розклад руху. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
